title: Linux Server Health Check
description: Collects CPU, memory, disk, swap and load figures from one Linux host over SSH and reports what breached the supplied thresholds. Read-only.

inputs.label: Target host
inputs.help: Hostname or IPv4 address of the server to inspect. One host per run.

inputs.label: SSH user
inputs.help: Service account used for the connection. Needs read access only — do not supply a root account.

inputs.label: Disk warning threshold (%)
inputs.help: Filesystems at or above this are reported as warnings.

inputs.label: Disk critical threshold (%)
inputs.help: Must be higher than the warning threshold.

inputs.label: Memory warning threshold (%)
inputs.help: Reported against used memory excluding buffers and cache.

inputs.label: Include swap
inputs.help: Turn off for hosts running without swap, so an absent swap device is not reported as a fault.

inputs.label: Output format
inputs.help: JSON is the machine-readable form the agent reasons over most reliably.

nodes.label: Collect load, CPU and memory
nodes.value:
{{SshUser}}@{{TargetHost}} LC_ALL=C awk '{printf "load_1m=%s load_5m=%s load_15m=%s
", $1, $2, $3}' /proc/loadavg; LC_ALL=C nproc | awk '{printf "cpu_cores=%s
", $1}'; LC_ALL=C free -m | awk '/^Mem:/ {printf "mem_total_mb=%s mem_used_mb=%s mem_used_pct=%.1f
", $2, $2-$7, ($2-$7)*100/$2}'

nodes.label: Collect filesystem usage
nodes.value: {{SshUser}}@{{TargetHost}} LC_ALL=C df -P -x tmpfs -x devtmpfs -x squashfs | awk 'NR>1 {gsub(/%/,"",$5); printf "fs=%s size=%s used_pct=%s mount=%s\n", $1, $2, $5, $6}'

nodes.label: Collect swap usage
nodes.value: {{SshUser}}@{{TargetHost}} LC_ALL=C free -m | awk '/^Swap:/ {if ($2==0) print "swap=absent"; else printf "swap_total_mb=%s swap_used_mb=%s swap_used_pct=%.1f\n", $2, $3, $3*100/$2}'

requires.customerText: SSH access to the servers you want checked, using a key you have given us. The account only needs to read system information.
The servers must be reachable from AutoOps on port 22.
